fm.name: FM Radio (Lineage Android 7, Q5 kernel ABI)
fm.reason: Android 7 audio routing and music-stream volume controls, with the original Lithium receiver JNI adapted to this kernel's ioctl sizes. Requires persist.af.audio_patch_fm=1 and a privileged system install.

recorder.name: Audio Recorder
recorder.reason: Mint SoundRecorder depends on missing legacy vendor APIs. This independent recorder successfully captured Ogg audio using the built-in microphone.
